packages.name: winfsp
packages.versionModel: the stable installer linked from https://winfsp.dev/rel/; the release tag names the series (v2.1) while the asset and the MSI ProductVersion name the build (2.1.25156)
packages.discovery: regex over https://winfsp.dev/rel/ matching releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-(?<version>).msi; the page also links nfs-win and sshfs-win, which are separate projects and do not match
packages.publisherCheck: GitHub release asset digest sha256:073a70e0... is byte-identical to an independent download

authenticode.subject: CN=NAVIMATICS LLC, O=NAVIMATICS LLC, L=KIRKLAND, S=Washington, C=US
authenticode.issuer: CN=DigiCert Global G3 Code Signing ECC SHA384 2021 CA1

commandModel.behaviour: the PowerShell entry point opens `msiexec /i <payload>` exactly like a double-click, refuses any arguments, and never runs an unattended install
commandModel.systemIntegration: piko system winfsp fails with 'No system integration declared'; Piko performs no elevation and registers no service

stateModel.installedPayload: C:\Program Files (x86)\WinFsp (written by the vendor installer, owned by the system, not by Piko)
stateModel.note: uninstalling the Piko package only deletes the saved installer copy; the installed driver and WinFsp.Launcher service remain

checks.checkLayout: passed: 1 file, 2,191,360 bytes, 0 unknown sizes, Authenticode Valid
checks.tests: tests/winfsp.test.mjs covers the installer-only model, the entry-point guard and series-tag/build discovery

isolatedInstall.pikoHome: temporary PIKO_HOME with a loopback HTTP source
isolatedInstall.result: installed 2.1.25156 into apps/winfsp/2.1.25156 (winfsp.msi + winfsp-setup.ps1), piko which winfsp-setup resolved to the generated script, invoking it with arguments was refused, uninstall removed the version directory

notVerified: real kernel driver installation and service registration (deliberately left to the vendor installer and the user)
driver load, drive-letter mounting and the WinFsp.Launcher service state
upgrade, downgrade and uninstall through the MSI
coexistence with an existing WinFsp install
any privileged installation or driver load
real mount behaviour on the target machine
notes: WinFsp cannot be packaged as a portable application: extracting an MSI scatters driver files that are useless without installation. The package therefore stores the signed vendor installer and exposes a single explicit entry point, following the same model as nvidia-app.
